posixInitialDiagnostic.explanation: Initial harness reused a store after native directory-rotation controls and incorrectly presumed full legacy marker health for the leaf-scope control. WSL1 changed ctime and fallback birthtime of the same dev/ino/mode/nlink/size/mtime marker. Final harness preserves this old fail-closed refusal as an explicit diagnostic and runs the leaf-scope control in a separate fresh healthy store with exact HEAD failure check and successful byte restoration

behavior.sourceCapture: Original successful EvolutionLedger constructor pins projected to deeply frozen data; exact new.target registration, Proxy/WeakMap/prototype checks; capture/recheck do not reacquire replaced directories
behavior.capabilityOperations: Original captured lstat/realpath only; no open, file content, lock, initializer, permission repair, signer, verifier, witness or caller replacement context
behavior.backendWiring: Private WeakMap binds actual local sourceLedger even when public ledger is the v2 wrapper. Existing backend descriptor/binding shape unchanged; no path-text reconstruction
behavior.lateFaultControl: Calibrate last artifact-files lstat in history.recheck, then actually clone source segments at that callback after the final journal verification returned; new final source check rejects, restoration reauthenticates original head/history

limitations: Metadata-only per-instance source journal directories; no source leaf inventory/content, complete v2 storage graph, witness/retention/manifest physical coverage, independent volume identity, installer/root authority, producer provenance or tenant-wide routing authority
No persistent full-precision pin/highwater, cross-process anti-rollback, arbitrary ABA defense, handle-relative openat or atomic graph snapshot
Only the exported capability is metadata-only. Constructors may prepare directories/permissions; ordinary journal/index/history APIs keep their existing locks, writes and recovery behavior

Initial index-factory capture may directly throw STORE_UNSAFE or TypeError; established index/history calls use their existing HOLD wrappers. Ordinary ledger.verify still has its original authority lock behavior

Native WSL1 metadata restoration does not imply a valid signed legacy marker after its ctime/fallback birthtime changed. That marker fence was not relaxed. Native Windows source-restoration history controls are separately validated

New digest is not the caller-declared anchor storageGraphDigest. Both fullPhysicalStorageGraphVerified and storageGraphDigestVerified remain false; all install/business/promotion authority remains held
No real RRSI A/B/C, production validation, release gate or physical-power-loss proof
